title: Web: Setup, Training plan
description: GET /api/coach/setup/training-plan. The saved week in force today and this week (Monday to Sunday) with what the user reported. POST /api/coach/setup/training-plan/day {weekday, sessions: [{name, type, time, optional}], from?} is a lasting change to that weekday (chat's update_training_plan; from today unless `from` is later) and returns this view. POST /api/coach/setup/training-plan/session {date, status: skipped|done|extra|clear, session_id?, extra_id?, type?, name?, kcal?, activity?, duration_min?, distance_km?} reports a session of this week (chat's set_session_status; kcal are the user's, or estimated by code from activity + duration) and returns {reported: {kcal, kcal_source, kcal_counted, estimate?} | null, section: this view}. A refusal is a 400 with the reason.

time.description: HH:MM, morning, midday, afternoon, evening, or null.

optional.description: May not happen, e.g. an optional easy run.

editable.description: A plan is saved (it seeds on first start); false: nothing to show or change.

valid_from.description: First day of the plan in force today; null: the plan as first seeded.

days.description: The saved week, Monday first; [] without a plan.

this_week.description: This week day by day with the plan of that day and the user's reports.

kcal.description: null: a wrestling or lifting session counting its setup value.

activities.description: Activities code can estimate kcal for (core param activity.met_by_activity).
